recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the removed Observation-genetics profile in core for FHIR-7198; any future clinical genomic reporting profile changes should be handled in the Genomics Reporting IG or current Clinical Genomics resource work.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Clinical Genomics issue against FHIR-core Observation saying the 2015May genetics material seemed unfinished and resolving to support reports without sequence information through Observation.component, add a Result extension for lists of mutations or variants, and add AllelicFrequency, CopyNumberEvent, and ReadCoverage.
initial_application: No current commit explicitly names FHIR-7198, but commit 45025abf6c99388591b956ef20357479b9a0e7ab, dated 2015-08-21 and titled "updated genetics", changed the old Observation genetics introduction and spreadsheet to add Observation.component guidance plus the Result, AllelicFrequency, CopyNumberEvent, and ReadCoverage content named by the Jira resolution.
additional_context: Later Clinical Genomics/O&O work superseded the old core profile. FHIR-19440 updated deprecation/refactoring language for Observation-genetics and genomics guidance, commit 3cfe12f1b4037e4fe922af288ba96fa49faf1435 removed outdated core Observation/DiagnosticReport/ServiceRequest genomics artifacts, and FHIR-28620 recorded stronger R4B deprecation guidance directing users to the Genomics Reporting IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has no active old Observation-genetics profile or fhir.ini entry to edit; source/genomics.html, GenomicStudy, and MolecularDefinition describe the current core/genomics split and point clinical genomic result reporting to maintained IG work.

related_jiras.note: Published issue updating Observation-genetics/genomics guidance to say the material was being refactored or potentially removed as part of the Genomics Reporting IG.
Published issue stating R4 Observation-genetics guidance, extensions, and examples were deprecated, should not be used, and were removed as of R5.
